title: Tamsin and the Cover
author: Felix Amberdale
blurb: Jonah Sandoval, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
